item.title: Smokers have left the building, yet the influence of tobacco lingers
item.description: Some lawmakers have been working under Georgia’s Gold Dome long enough to remember when the place reeked of cigarettes. The post Smokers have left the building, yet the influence of tobacco lingers appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: National Wild Turkey Federation joins Georgia Cyber Center
item.description: The Georgia Cyber Innovation & Training Center at Augusta University has announced the National Wild Turkey Federation as its newest resident partner, marking a collaboration that brings together conservation and technology. The post National Wild Turkey Federation joins Georgia Cyber Center appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Special hearing before Board Commissioners’ last vote on new comprehensive plan yields strong views related to data center development
item.description: Thursday night Columbia County citizens took advantage of the opportunity to air their grievances with the county about the latest draft of Foundations for the Future, the county’s new iteration of its comprehensive plan. The post Special hearing before Board Commissioners’ last vote on new comprehensive plan yields strong views related to data center development appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Double tax ask: Two measures headed for ballot
item.description: Augusta voters could see two separate sales tax questions on the May 19 ballot if the commission approves two referendum resolutions Tuesday. The post Double tax ask: Two measures headed for ballot appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Our favorite snow photos from across the CSRA
item.description: Snow fell across the Central Savannah River Area this weekend, and the community responded with an outpouring of images showing how the Augusta-Aiken region experienced this rare winter event. The post Our favorite snow photos from across the CSRA appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Curfew for residents continues following icing of roads overnight
item.description: The curfew for Richmond County continues until noon today, Sunday, Feb. 1 The post Curfew for residents continues following icing of roads overnight appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Weekend snow leads to Monday closures, e-learning across CSRA school districts
item.description: The snow is starting to go away but refreezing temperatures and icy roads are prompting schedule changes across several CSRA school districts Monday, Feb. 2, with systems citing hazardous travel conditions and continued safety concerns. The post Weekend snow leads to Monday closures, e-learning across CSRA school districts appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Homeless man found dead on 13th Street in Augusta as temps plunge to 19 degrees
item.description: A homeless man was found dead Sunday on 13th Street at Walton Way in Augusta amid a snow storm and below freezing temperatures, authorities said. The post Homeless man found dead on 13th Street in Augusta as temps plunge to 19 degrees appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: The Augusta Players and The Imperial Theatre to merge
item.description: The Augusta Players, the theatre company that has entertained the city for some 80 years, is merging with over-century-old Imperial Theatre. The post The Augusta Players and The Imperial Theatre to merge appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: A new retail center has been proposed in Evans, along the intersection of Washington and Hardy McManus Roads. The post Commercial development proposed at intersection of Hardy McManus and Washington Road appeared first on The Augusta Press.
